rationale: XDriver is a Python CLI tool (v1.0.1) that patches a local Playwright v1.52.0 installation by replacing the Playwright driver package directory with a pre-patched 'turnstilebrowser-playwright-core' v1.49.0 fork. It targets specific anti-bot evasion techniques with no architecture docs or test coverage. The Python surface is a thin 9-source-file activator/patcher (7 directories, ~340 total lines). The bundled JS payload is the entire turnstilebrowser-modified Playwright core (large but third-party, not authored in this repo). README claims success against Cloudflare WAF, Turnstile, Datadome, Kasada, Imperva, Fingerprint.com, CreepJS, and others. The repo has no tests, no architecture docs, no CI beyond PyPI publishing, and the example files (playwright_sync.py, playwright_async.py) are empty stubs. The original repo URL is github.com/arjun-sha/XDriver with stated author Arjun Shankar; the bundled package ships under 'turnstilebrowser-playwright-core' by Nick Webson (turnstilebrowser.net). Heritage is none because there is no observed source evidence that it was designed for or directly addresses any Veridian pipeline concern beyond general stealth — the patching approach (replacing Playwright's driver wholesale) is not composable into a modular scraping stack.
